bodyHtml:
Friday, November 20 is the day after Suneung - the exam is over, and across Korea the relief is almost audible: no more pre-dawn commutes to exam halls, no more hushed waiting rooms full of parents. In the Saju calendar, today is a Musul (戊戌) day - Yang Earth (戊) sitting on the Dog's own branch (戌). Dog's dominant hidden stem is also Yang Earth, so today is earth doubled straight through - heavy and settled rather than sharp. The sixty-day nayin table does turn a new page today: yesterday's Jeongyu day closed out Sanha-hwa (山下火), Fire Under the Mountain, and today opens Pyeongji-mok (平地木), Wood of the Flatland - even though the day pillar itself is pure earth, not wood at all. It's also D-2 to Soseol (Minor Snow), the solar term landing this Sunday, November 22. Here are the three zodiac animals reading today's settling energy best.

1. Dog - Today Is Your Own Day, and It's Already Where the Story Ends

When the day's branch matches your own zodiac sign, the day doesn't test you with something foreign - it mirrors you. Today that mirror lands at an unusual spot: Dog is also the storage point of the Tiger-Horse-Dog Fire trine (寅午戌), the place where that trine's energy finally gets banked rather than spent. For Dog, that means a day built for settling, not launching - closing a loop, filing away what's finished, letting the quiet after the exam actually be quiet.

2. Horse - Riding the Last of the Fire Trine's Heat

Horse sits at the flourishing peak of that same Tiger-Horse-Dog trine, the point where its energy burns brightest before it banks. For Horse, that means today still carries real heat - a conversation, a deal, or a plan that's been building keeps its momentum, even as the day around it turns toward rest.

3. Tiger - Where a Brand New Spark Catches, Just as Today's Page Turns

Tiger is the starting point of the same trine, where its fire first catches rather than finishes. That lines up neatly with today's nayin table turning an actual new page: for Tiger, something genuinely new is worth starting today, even while the day itself leans toward closing things down for everyone else.

Not One of Today's Three? That's Fine.

A zodiac-animal reading works from your birth year alone - a broad read on a day that this year's exam-takers and everyone else alike all share.
